description: Connect to PastReads to explore your reading library, search highlights and notes, and get answers grounded in what you’ve read.

defaultPrompt: Search my book highlights for notes about habits.
What books and articles are in my PastReads library?
Summarize what I've highlighted about leadership.
interface.longDescription: Chat with your book highlights. Ask questions about what you’ve read and get answers grounded in your own highlights from books, Kindle, Kobo, Apple Books, KOReader, websites, and Readwise.

positive.prompt: Search my PastReads highlights for anything about habits.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching highlights from the connected account with book context, without inventing quotes.

positive.prompt: What books are in my PastReads library?
positive.expected_behavior: List books/sources from the connected library, including titles and authors when available.

positive.prompt: Tell me more about one of the books in my library, including how many highlights it has.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify a book from list_sources, then use get_source to report highlight/note counts and related details.

positive.prompt: Show highlights tagged with one of my tags.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve a tag via list_tags, then return highlights for that tag via search_highlights.
Report that no matching highlights were found instead of inventing results.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my PastReads highlights.
Add a new highlight to my PastReads library for Atomic Habits.
Show highlights from another user's PastReads account.

name: pastreads
